post.summary: Returns the customer's cards the assistant may talk about.

customerNo.description: 8-digit customer number; may be sent as a string or as a number, both are accepted.

aiFlow.description: Which use case is asking; for this one "CardOps" (not validated in test).

cards.description: Array of card objects, each with cardNumber (masked in the test environment, first 6 and last 4 digits visible, e.g. "540000******1234"), cardNumberLast4, productName (free text from the card system), status (only active cards come back: "A") and isMainCard (true/false; false for a card that isn't t

validCardsCount.description: Number of valid cards in the list.

400.description: INVALID_ARGUMENTS_ERROR - A required field is missing or empty (message names the field).

404.description: FB_IVR_CHANNEL_102 - Customer has no valid card.

500.description: FBE00099 - Technical error on Freya's side.

post.summary: Returns statement and due dates and debt per currency for a card.

cardNumber.description: Always send the cardNumber exactly as cards.list returned it; don't rebuild it from digits the caller says. In the test environment it comes back masked; build so it works with the masked form.
Masked differently from the card list (first 4 + last 4, "5400********1234"); don't use it to match against the list.

cardNumberLast4.description: Last four digits; not unique across cards — don't assume uniqueness.

productName.description: Free text from the card system.

statementDate.description: The last issued statement date, dd.MM.yyyy.

lastPayDate.description: Due date of the last issued statement.

debtTL.description: TL debt block: statementPaymentStatus ("HAS_DEBT"/"NO_DEBT"), transferAmount (carried over from the previous period), statementDebt, minPayment, remainingDebt, remainingMinPayment (what is left after payments made since), currentPeriodExpense (spending after the statement), totalDebt (includes spend

debtUSD.description: USD debt block, same fields as debtTL; can be missing.

debtEUR.description: EUR debt block, same fields as debtTL; can be missing.

debtGBP.description: GBP debt block, same fields as debtTL; some cards have no GBP block at all.

statementPaymentStatus.description: Top level, for the card overall: "HAS_DEBT" or "NO_DEBT".

400.description: INVALID_ARGUMENTS_ERROR - A required field is missing or empty (empty card number).

500.description: FBE00099 - Technical error on Freya's side.

post.summary: Returns the card's current statement week and day and joint statement info.

cardNumber.description: Card number, exactly as cards.list returned it.

productName.description: Product name from the card system.

statementWeek.description: 1 to 4, the week of the month the statement is cut.

relationType.description: Empty string when the card has its own statement. "M" or "C" when two cards share one statement: "M" = this is the main card of the pair, "C" = this is the card linked to it.

relatedCardNumber.description: The other card of a shared statement; empty string when there is none.

relatedCardProductName.description: Product name of the other card; empty string when there is none.

400.description: INVALID_ARGUMENTS_ERROR - A required field is missing or empty (message names the field).

500.description: FBE00099 - Technical error on Freya's side.

post.summary: Preview only: returns what the statement and due dates would be with the requested week (does not change anything).

cardNumber.description: Card number, exactly as cards.list returned it.

newStatementWeek.description: 1-4, number or string both fine. Asking for the week the card already has gives an error — there is nothing to preview, so don't call it for that.

statementDay.description: The card's current statementDay from statement.week.get.

statementDate.description: The first statement date under the requested week, dd.MM.yyyy.

statementDueDate.description: The first due date under the requested week. Note the due date is statementDueDate here, not lastPayDate like elsewhere.

statementDay.description: The statement day under the requested week.

400.description: INVALID_ARGUMENTS_ERROR - A required field is missing or empty (message names the field).

500.description: FBE00099 - Technical error on Freya's side.

cardNumber.description: Card number, exactly as cards.list returned it.

statementDay.description: Required by the request model even though the backend recalculates the day; send the current day.

statementWeek.description: Comes back as a string here (numbers everywhere else).

statementDay.description: Comes back as a string here (numbers everywhere else); ignore it — the dates to tell the caller are the ones from statement.week.decide.

400.description: INVALID_ARGUMENTS_ERROR - A required field is missing or empty (message names the field).

401.description: Token missing or expired. Get a new token and retry once.

500.description: FBE00099 - Technical error on Freya's side.

post.summary: Returns the customer's registered e-mail / phone.

intAddressInfoType.description: "E" e-mail, "P" phone, "B" both. Empty value gives a 400 ("intAddressInfoType cannot be empty"). The test environment returns the same answer whatever you ask for.

communicationType.description: "Both" when an e-mail is registered, "Phone" when only a phone is registered. Check ibanEmail, not only the type.

ibanCountryCode.description: The iban* prefix is historical, it has nothing to do with IBANs.

ibanEmail.description: The registered e-mail; empty when there is none.

ttsEmail.description: The same address prepared for reading aloud (today identical in practice).

400.description: INVALID_ARGUMENTS_ERROR - Empty intAddressInfoType ("intAddressInfoType cannot be empty").

500.description: FBE00099 - Technical error on Freya's side.

post.summary: Sends the statement PDF by e-mail.

cardNumber.description: Card number, exactly as cards.list returned it.

statementDate.description: The statementDate from cards.balance (the issued statement), dd.MM.yyyy.

emailAddress.description: The backend sends to whatever is in this field. It does not check it against the registered address.

400.description: INVALID_ARGUMENTS_ERROR - A required field is missing or empty (message names the field).

404.description: FB_IVR_CHANNEL_107 - No statement document to send.

500.description: FBE00099 - Technical error on Freya's side.
